tldr: US inflation rose to 3.7% in September, fueling concerns about potential interest rate hikes and contributing to a market downturn.
Ukrainian officials reported new restrictions on Starlink satellite internet services, impacting the country's drone operations and missions.
Pope Leo's recovery from lung cancer surgery is progressing as expected, with doctors reporting he has begun walking and is eating normally.

market.why: Major US stock indices declined, influenced by a higher-than-expected US inflation rate of 3.7% for September, driven largely by increased energy prices. This inflation report fueled fears of potential interest rate hikes, adding to market uncertainty. Additionally, Bank of America's shares fell following a revenue miss and a regulatory penalty.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield decreased by 0.02% as of October 13. However, the provided articles do not offer a specific reason for this particular decrease, with one article reporting that the yield moved higher on October 14 after the latest inflation data.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, increased slightly by 0.06. This rise can be attributed to increased market uncertainty stemming from the higher-than-expected US inflation report for September and the associated fears of potential interest rate hikes.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased by 0.12% to 7.4%, as reported in Freddie Mac's weekly survey released on October 8. The provided articles do not offer a direct explanation for this specific weekly increase, as the latest inflation data and a revised mortgage rate forecast from Fannie Mae were reported on October 14, after the survey's release date.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Microsoft has developed a new machine learning tool capable of providing more accurate weather forecasts two to six weeks in advance, potentially benefiting sectors like farming and emergency response.

Anthropic has issued a warning that small AI models could self-replicate and spread across internet-of-things (IoT) devices, potentially creating a new generation of difficult-to-contain computer worms.
ASML reported strong new orders, which helped alleviate concerns that the recent boom in AI spending might be losing momentum.

world.summary: A container ship sank near the Strait of Hormuz, and another cargo vessel was reportedly sinking, amidst a significant increase in Iranian attacks on shipping in the region.
Pope Leo's recovery from lung cancer surgery is progressing as planned, with doctors stating he has begun walking in his hospital room and is eating normally after the operation.
Mont Blanc, Europe's highest peak, has decreased in height by more than a meter over the past year, now measuring 4,807.47 meters above sea level due to changes in the Alpine climate.
UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham hosted Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at Downing Street, stating his desire to "repair bridges" between Ukraine and the United States.

us.summary: The Social Security Administration announced a 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) for 2027, which will increase average monthly retirement benefit checks by $75.
A federal judge ruled to extend White House access for media outlets CNN, MS Now, and Politico, maintaining that President Trump's previous ban on their coverage was likely illegal.
Organized criminal rings are reportedly targeting SNAP recipients through EBT card skimming, taking millions of dollars due to the government program's outdated security features.

science.summary: Researchers across North America are attaching tiny transmitters to Monarch butterflies to track their migration to Mexico and gain further insight into their journey and challenges.
Clinicians are urging a reduction in screen time in English classrooms, warning that extensive technology use is contributing to a rise in health issues such as short-sightedness among students.
